decisions.reason: False positive: the published Hom theorem Proof 1.1–2.1 proves the flagged-source form and exactness degree by degree, then projects the word target idempotent; Proof 3.1 proves the dual flagged-target exactness. Its special-Hom supplier explicitly covers arbitrary flagged sources/targets. These canonical-flag sequences license both lifts in classification Proof 5.1; the p_x image equality makes the composite identity on the top layer, hence nonnilpotent and invertible in the finite local endomorphism algebra.

Confirmed nonfatal convention defect: reduction has degrees 2,0,0,-2 and hence graded dimension v^2+2+v^{-2}. Corrected Example and Verification 1.1 to distinguish this polynomial from its v=1 ordinary dimension 4, and clarified ordinary dimensions in 4.1. The explicit cyclic-generator proof gives scalar degree-zero endomorphisms, hence two-letter indecomposability; KL triangularity and the supplied rank-two triple splitting are preserved.

Confirmed nonfatal dual-type error in Remark (vi): right S-duality does not give real vector-space duality of the unreduced polynomial bimodule. For the empty word S, degree 2 is nonzero but real graded dual degree 2 is zero. Replaced that sentence with the finite homogeneous right-basis argument identifying the reduction with its real dual; Definition is unchanged. The trace and induced unit-determinant pairing remain perfect.

False positive: the actual invariant-form supplier proves reduced-word bottom positivity in Proof 1.1, then normalizes the intrinsic form to bottom value one in Proof 2.1. Positive deletion coefficients and at least one reduced deletion give a strictly positive top coefficient; nonreduced deletions vanish by normalized degree spans. This proof establishes the precise normalization assertion used here without assuming hard Lefschetz. The HR definition correctly includes S(x), while embedded HR is unconditional.

Confirmed nonfatal type defect: invariant S-valued forms identify finite right-free bimodules with D B=Hom_{-S}(B,S), not their real algebraic duals. Replaced the ill-typed real transpose citation by the explicit degree-zero bimodule formula g*=Phi_By^{-1} Dg Phi_M and its invariance proof. This preserves the actual local form, symmetry and positive scalar comparison; all three direct item consumers use only those unchanged properties.

Confirmed fatal logic defect in Statement (d): a stable graded direct summand need not have centered hard Lefschetz, as the top line of the two-degree string shows. Added an operator-stable complement to the direct-summand clause and proved restriction by blockwise injectivity and surjectivity. The symmetric-dimension HR clause is unchanged. Parts (a)–(c) already have bimodule inclusion/projection commuting with rho and remain sound; Hodge theorem F5/8.1 uses precisely these unchanged top-summand clauses.

False positive: Hom theorem Proof 1.1–2.1 proves freeness and rank additivity for arbitrary Delta-filtered sources and Soergel targets, including Delta_y and the quotient Q; its special-Hom supplier explicitly states the flagged domains. The positive-degree kernel, Hilbert-series comparison, right-split graph-support inclusion, and HR(y) then give injective bottom evaluation and the adjoint isometry. Rechecked F4/3.1 against the corrected right S-dual definition: these uses remain well typed. No item edit is needed.

Confirmed dependency-citation gap: F5/F7 dropped the actual multiplicities m_{z,1} and their parity zeros; additionally F7 imported a tensor perverse bound not stated by the linearity theorem. Restored multiplicities everywhere and proved the bound in 4.2: under S(z), actual standard filtration multiplicities make mu(u,z) nonnegative, the ascent product is perverse without S(zs), descents contract, and stupid-filtration triangles preserve the shift bound. The forward cancellation and ker(d3) form identity then give the three hL cases with their existing hypotheses. Statement unchanged.

Confirmed nonfatal hypothesis misquotation in F7: unshifted ascent decomposition needs ys>y and S(<ys); descents have shifts ±1. Replaced F7 with both exact cases and separated the positive comparison of B_y forms, which needs S(y) alone and passes to induced tensor forms. The induction uses only that latter comparison in 4.1/6.1, with HR(z) explicitly supplied to the deformed theorem. Each new ascent is proved before the next character, and all positive descents follow after S and HR, so no circular hypothesis is introduced.

Confirmed fatal logic defect in the descent clause: the triangular matrix is only the right-reduced operator; positive-degree right multiplications survive on the unreduced bimodule. For rank one rho=alpha_s/2 and zeta=1, middle multiplication squares to right multiplication by alpha_s^2/4, contradicting the claimed unreduced square-zero off-diagonal part. Corrected Statement and Proof 3.1 to the right reduction, preserving the character identity, all Hodge conclusions, positive descent implication and zero-parameter failure. Both direct consumers use only the unchanged character equality.
